subject: Request: short-term credit allowance for Beacon Health POC load validation
messages:
From: Alice Gomez <alice.gomez@beaconhealth.com>
To: jonas_weber@redwood.ai
Cc: procure@beaconhealth.com
Date: Wed, 15 Sep 2027 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Beacon Health POC – short-term credit ask for load validation

Hi Jonas,

Thanks for the demo last week — the team is excited to run an end-to-end load validation in our preprod environment. We're planning a 72-hour soak the week of Sep 27 to validate throughput and 95th percentile latency under realistic traffic.

Ask: would Redwood be able to provision a short-term credit allowance (sandbox/top-up) to support the run? Our initial estimate is ~1.2M tokens (mixed text + embeddings) during the window. We attached the POC_TestPlan_v2.xlsx and an SLO_Matrix.pdf for context.

Constraints: we need the allowance to be active by Sep 26 PST and it should be single-use (expire Oct 10). Procurement is copying me on approvals (procure@beaconhealth.com).

Appreciate any quick guidance on timing and who will confirm the grant.

Best,
Alice Gomez
Sr. Engineering Manager | Beacon Health
alice.gomez@beaconhealth.com

Attachments: POC_TestPlan_v2.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet), SLO_Matrix.pdf (application/pdf)
From: jonas_weber@redwood.ai
To: Alice Gomez <alice.gomez@beaconhealth.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 15 Sep 2027 10:09:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Beacon Health POC – short-term credit ask for load validation

Hi Alice — great to hear, and thanks for the clear runbook.

We're happy to support the soak. To make sure we size the allowance correctly: can you confirm the expected concurrency pattern (steady vs spike), average token length per request, and whether embeddings will be batched on your side? A short answers list is fine.

Internal note: looping in Marissa on the commercial side to coordinate a one-time sandbox top-up and verify expiration window.

Next steps: once I have the concurrency profile I'll propose a credit amount and get a manager sign-off. We aim to have the allowance live by Sep 26 if we get confirmation this week.

Thanks —
Jonas Weber
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
jonas_weber@redwood.ai

From: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
To: jonas_weber@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 16 Sep 2027 08:32:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Beacon Health POC – short-term credit ask for load validation

Jonas — thanks for the heads-up. Quick ops/commercial thinking:
- If Beacon's estimate is ~1.2M tokens, I suggest we provision a 1.5M token buffer to avoid mid-run failures.
- Recommend expiration Oct 10 as requested but flag that we should record it as a one-off promotional sandbox (no auto-renew).
- We should also require Beacon to run with default batching off (they’ll use our batch API) to ensure consistent latency results; add a note in the activation.

Ben — can you check current capacity for the Sep 27 window and confirm we won't need to move capacity from other pools? If capacity is tight, propose an alternative weekend or allow our dedicated pool fallback.

Thanks —
Marissa Cole
Sr. Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai

> On Wed, Sep 15, 2027 at 10:09 AM jonas_weber@redwood.ai wrote:
> > Hi Alice — great to hear, and thanks for the clear runbook.
From: ben_carter@redwood.ai
To: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, jonas_weber@redwood.ai
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 16 Sep 2027 11:07:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Beacon Health POC – short-term credit ask for load validation

Marissa / team — checked infra schedules for Sep 27–29. We have a maintenance window on Sep 28 in one region but capacity in us-west2 can absorb the run. I recommend:
- Approve 1.5M token credit (sandbox top-up) active Sep 26 00:00 PDT -> expire Oct 10 23:59 PDT.
- Set routing policy to prefer hosted pool in us-west2 for the soak; fallback to dedicated reserved pool if latency spikes.

I'll tag the run in our capacity tracking board and notify infra ops. No migration needed.

—Ben
Ben Carter
Capacity Planning Lead, Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.ai

- Routing: prefer hosted us-west2; automatic fallback to dedicated pool as Ben specified.
